title: agora.primitives/v1
description: R05 wire primitives shared by every family. Identifiers are opaque UUIDs, 64-bit integers travel as decimal strings, times are UTC RFC 3339, digests are algorithm-tagged SHA-256.

Uuid.description: RFC 9562 UUID in hyphenated hexadecimal form; either letter case is accepted, never the urn prefix.

Revision.description: Nonnegative 64-bit integer as a decimal string without sign, leading zeros or exponent; the pattern is the exact bound 18446744073709551615.

Timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 date-time with the literal Z designator and up to nine fractional digits; numeric offsets are rejected.

Digest.description: Algorithm-tagged SHA-256 over canonical bytes, lowercase hexadecimal.
